title: l-Carnitine relieves cachexia-related skeletal muscle fibrosis by inducing deltex E3 ubiquitin ligase 3L to negatively regulate the Runx2/COL1A1 axis.
authors: Lu, Zongliang; Wang, Li; Huo, Zhenyu; Li, Na; Tong, Ning; Chong, Feifei; Liu, Jie; Zhang, Yaowen; Xu, Hongxia
journal: Journal of cachexia, sarcopenia and muscle
one_liner_zh: 该文研究左卡尼汀通过DTX3L泛素化Runx2缓解癌症恶病质骨骼肌纤维化，虽涉及转录因子Runx2与COL1A1调控，但核心是湿实验与疾病表型，无AI或物理模拟方法，且非蛋白-DNA互作建模。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cancer cachexia-induced skeletal muscle fibrosis (SMF) impairs muscle regeneration, alters the muscle structure and function, reduces the efficacy of anticancer drugs, diminishes the patient's quality of life and shortens overall survival. RUNX family transcription factor 2 (Runx2), a transcription factor, and collagen type I alpha 1 chain (COL1A1), the principal constituent of SMF, have been linked previously, with Runx2 shown to directly modulate COL1A1 mRNA levels. l-Carnitine, a marker of cancer cachexia, can alleviate fibrosis in liver and kidney models; however, its role in cancer cachexia-associated fibrosis and the involvement of Runx2 in the process remain unexplored. METHODS: Female C57 mice (48 weeks old) were inoculated subcutaneously with MC38 cells to establish a cancer cachexia model. A 5 mg/kg dose of l-carnitine or an equivalent volume of water was administered for 14 days via oral gavage, followed by assessments of muscle function (grip strength) and fibrosis. To elucidate the interplay between the deltex E3 ubiquitin ligase 3L(DTX3L)/Runx2/COL1A1 axis and fibrosis in transforming growth factor beta 1-stimulated NIH/3T3 cells, a suite of molecular techniques, including quantitative real-time PCR, western blot analysis, co-immunoprecipitation, molecular docking, immunofluorescence and Duolink assays, were used. The relevance of the DTX3L/Runx2/COL1A1 axis in the gastrocnemius was also explored in the in vivo model. RESULTS: l-Carnitine supplementation reduced cancer cachexia-induced declines in grip strength (>88.2%, P < 0.05) and the collagen fibre area within the gastrocnemius (>57.9%, P < 0.05). At the 5 mg/kg dose, l-carnitine also suppressed COL1A1 and alpha-smooth muscle actin (alpha-SMA) protein expression, which are markers of SMF and myofibroblasts. Analyses of the TRRUST database indicated that Runx2 regulates both COL1A1 and COL1A2. In vitro, l-carnitine diminished Runx2 protein levels and promoted its ubiquitination. Overexpression of Runx2 abolished the effects of l-carnitine on COL1A1 and alpha-SMA. Co-immunoprecipitation, molecular docking, immunofluorescence and Duolink assays confirmed an interaction between DTX3L and Runx2, with l-carnitine enhancing this interaction to promote Runx2 ubiquitination. l-Carnitine supplementation restored DTX3L levels to those observed under non-cachectic conditions, both in vitro and in vivo. Knockdown of DTX3L abolished the effects of l-carnitine on Runx2, COL1A1 and alpha-SMA in vitro. The expression of DTX3L was negatively correlated with the levels of Runx2 and COL1A1 in untreated NIH/3T3 cells. CONCLUSIONS: This study revealed a previously unrecognized link between Runx2 and DTX3L in SMF and demonstrated that l-carnitine exerted a significant therapeutic impact on cancer cachexia-associated SMF, potentially through the upregulation of DTX3L.
abstract_zh: 背景：癌症恶病质诱导的骨骼肌纤维化（SMF）损害肌肉再生，改变肌肉结构和功能，降低抗癌药物疗效，降低患者生活质量并缩短总生存期。RUNX家族转录因子2（Runx2）作为一种转录因子，以及I型胶原蛋白α1链（COL1A1）作为SMF的主要成分，此前已被关联，且Runx2被证明直接调节COL1A1 mRNA水平。左卡尼汀作为癌症恶病质的标志物，可缓解肝脏和肾脏模型中的纤维化；然而，其在癌症恶病质相关纤维化中的作用以及Runx2在此过程中的参与仍未探索。方法：雌性C57小鼠（48周龄）皮下接种MC38细胞以建立癌症恶病质模型。通过口服灌胃给予5 mg/kg剂量的左卡尼汀或等体积水，持续14天，随后评估肌肉功能（握力）和纤维化。为阐明deltex E3泛素连接酶3L（DTX3L）/Runx2/COL1A1轴与转化生长因子β1刺激的NIH/3T3细胞中纤维化之间的相互作用，使用了一系列分子技术，包括定量实时PCR、蛋白质印迹分析、共免疫沉淀、分子对接、免疫荧光和Duolink实验。在体内模型中，还探讨了DTX3L/Runx2/COL1A1轴在腓肠肌中的相关性。结果：左卡尼汀补充减少了癌症恶病质诱导的握力下降（>88.2%，P < 0.05）和腓肠肌内胶原纤维面积（>57.9%，P < 0.05）。在5 mg/kg剂量下，左卡尼汀还抑制了COL1A1和α-平滑肌肌动蛋白（alpha-SMA）蛋白表达，这些是SMF和肌成纤维细胞的标志物。TRRUST数据库分析表明，Runx2调节COL1A1和COL1A2。体外实验中，左卡尼汀降低了Runx2蛋白水平并促进其泛素化。Runx2的过表达消除了左卡尼汀对COL1A1和alpha-SMA的影响。共免疫沉淀、分子对接、免疫荧光和Duolink实验确认了DTX3L与Runx2之间的相互作用，且左卡尼汀增强这种相互作用以促进Runx2泛素化。左卡尼汀补充在体外和体内均将DTX3L水平恢复至非恶病质条件下观察到的水平。DTX3L的敲低在体外消除了左卡尼汀对Runx2、COL1A1和alpha-SMA的影响。在未处理的NIH/3T3细胞中，DTX3L的表达与Runx2和COL1A1水平呈负相关。结论：本研究揭示了SMF中Runx2与DTX3L之间先前未被识别的联系，并证明左卡尼汀对癌症恶病质相关SMF具有显著的治疗作用，可能通过上调DTX3L实现。
